verdict.stance: Distressed / Nov-26 LSE Share Suspension, CEO Exit & $20m Offtake Lifeline
verdict.summary: In Nov-26 Petra Diamonds' LSE shares were suspended after delaying FY26 audited accounts and its CEO resigned amid Finsch business rescue proceedings. Liquidity was temporarily patched by a $20m Cullinan diamond advance-payment offtake and a 12-month senior lender extension ahead of the Jan-27 deferred interest deadline.

positives: 2L notes ($228m) already extended from Mar-26 to Mar-30 with PIK/share-coupon flexibility.
Cullinan flagship mine provides core blue/type-IIa diamond optionality if tender prices recover.
Strategic Materials market positioning in South Africa supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: S&P Selective Default (SD, Jul-26) on interest deferral to Jan-2027.
Finsch mine in business rescue; LSE shares suspended Nov-26 due to delayed FY26 audit.
Depressed rough diamond market + stronger ZAR squeezing margins (net debt $322m vs $27m FY25 EBITDA).
